WITH sales_by_code AS (
    SELECT product_code, MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_rows, COUNT(sold_quantity) AS quantity_rows
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
),
product_counts AS (
    SELECT division, product, COUNT(*) AS codes_per_product
    FROM main.hardware_dim_product
    GROUP BY division, product
),
dimension_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS dimension_rows,
           COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS unique_codes,
           COUNT(DISTINCT division) AS divisions,
           SUM(product IS NULL OR division IS NULL) AS unlabeled_codes
    FROM main.hardware_dim_product
)
SELECT d.*,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_counts) AS named_products,
       (SELECT MAX(codes_per_product) FROM product_counts) AS max_codes_per_product,
       MIN(s.first_date) AS first_sales_date,
       MAX(s.last_date) AS last_sales_date,
       SUM(s.sales_rows) AS sales_rows,
       SUM(s.quantity_rows) AS quantity_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_code IS NULL THEN s.sales_rows ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_sales_rows
FROM sales_by_code AS s
LEFT JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
CROSS JOIN dimension_counts AS d

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT total_quantity_sold,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY division
               ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC, product
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity_sold) AS overall_avg_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 3
LIMIT 1
